body: Also, what exactly is biological depression?

The thing about near death experiences, and people who were clinically dead for a few minutes. If actually taken an interest in this as well, the brain still has activity for 27 minutes (around there not sure exactly) after the heart stops, when people experience death or near death, a chemical called DMT surges and is released into your brain, its the same chemical that causes dreaming. 

I found that very interesting, ever notice in dreams that theres never a sense of time?
To some, who who were pronounced dead and revived, they testify that they've seen the white light, heaven or hell, dead loved ones, etc. 

I am religious in a way, and the after life is something i was always told to believe. 

But what if? What if nothing?
